name: tpa
description: Teleport requests: !tpa <player> asks to go to them, !tpahere <player> asks them to come to you; they answer !tpaccept or !tpdeny.
author: pooper

timeout.description: Seconds before an unanswered request expires

cooldown.description: Seconds a player must wait between requests

commands.name: !tpa
commands.description: Ask to teleport to a player

commands.name: !tpahere
commands.description: Ask a player to teleport to you

commands.name: !tpaccept
commands.description: Accept the newest teleport request (or a named player's)
